title: Classic Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional French-inspired North African dish made with tender chicken and aromatic spices, slow-cooked in a flavorful tagine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the ground cumin, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper (if using). Cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the oven and cook for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs (if desired).
